title: Dialog claiming project.godot file has been modified outside editor appears over and over when running project with `-e`
body: ### Tested versions I have reproduced this since forever, at least from 4.0 dont remember if it was a problem in 3.x ### System information Windows 11 - Godot Engine v4.7.beta1.official.1c8cc9e7e - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #2: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU ### Issue description One of the features i love is the ability of debugging my addons adding `-e` to the `editor/run/main_run_args` project setting However this dialog that prompts over and over is super annoying and breaks the workflow It is even worse when using the embedded window, because it prompts all the time because Godot Editor focuses one window or the other when the mouse moves between them ### Steps to reproduce - Create a blank project - Go to project settings and set `editor/run/main_run_args` to `-e` - Create an empry scene and run it **Expected Result** - Last modified time of project.godot changes, but md5 has is the same, so no prompt about modified file shows up **Actual Result** - The "Files Modified Outside Editor" appears over and over while trying to do stuff like using the 2D selector or the remote scene tree ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A Any blank project works
